headline: San Francisco Estate Sells for Record $28.5M Amid AI Wealth Surge
summary: An eight-bedroom San Francisco mansion in Presidio Heights sold for $28.5 million—$10 million above its listing price—in a record transaction driven by the artificial intelligence boom.
why: High-end residential real estate prices in primary technology hubs reflect localized wealth creation tied to startup exits and executive compensation in the artificial intelligence sector.
